/.purpose: Understand HELM and choose a guide.

/foundation.purpose: Understand six simple principles and try a useful action.

/practitioners.purpose: Choose tasks, set limits, check results, and learn from the work.

/leadership.purpose: Agree responsibilities, support learning, and review team results.

/competencies.audience: People doing AI-assisted work across content, engineering, sales and account management
/competencies.purpose: Choose a competency and role, learn a practical approach and use an example and exercise to improve that skill.

/roles.purpose: Find guidance for discussing responsibilities and skills.

/roles/software-engineer.purpose: Discuss how to build and review software with agents.

/roles/staff-engineer.purpose: Discuss technical direction and help teams work with agents.

/roles/engineering-manager.purpose: Support team learning and review the impact of agent work.

/roles/sre-devops-engineer.purpose: Discuss reliable agent-assisted operations and human responsibilities.

/roles/qa-engineer.purpose: Discuss how to check the quality of agent work.

/roles/platform-engineer.purpose: Discuss shared tools and support for teams using agents.

/roles/product-manager.purpose: Make goals clear and check that agent work meets user needs.

/roles/product-designer.purpose: Discuss how to design and review experiences involving agents.

/roles/competency-map.purpose: Explore the skills described in role guides and choose what to discuss.

/evidence.purpose: Find further reading and practical limits to consider when using the guides.

/roadmap.purpose: Understand the small set of planned improvements.

/updates.purpose: See what changed, why it helps, and where to read it.

/changelog.purpose: Find a clear history of reader-facing changes.

/licensing.purpose: Understand how to share, adapt, and credit the material.

/404.html.purpose: Find a useful route back to the guides.
